# gramlot-js-server 0.2.16 — Offline editor collections

The static directory exporter shares optional collection code once across all routes, including the bundled Typst compiler and fonts. The gallery includes CodeMirror, HTML/Jodit, Markdown and Typst examples with browser PDF.

The Worker remains independent of the browser inline compiler. Hosted Node/Bun behavior and nested routes retain the published contracts. Serverless does not provide filesystem writes or execute Python recipes.

Requires Gramlot 0.3.9 and Gramlot Examples 0.3.12. All three JavaScript workspace packages share this release version.
